title: The Matrix — Prompt Zero (The Red Pill Purge)
subtitle: 1999 Wachowski Emerald-Green 2.39:1 Noir · Max-3 Cast: Gigi (Morpheus), Zach & Damon

setups.MX2_WIDE: Symmetrical 1999 Bill Pope emerald-green tinted Lafayette Hotel room; rain sheets down gothic windows; Gigi left seated in cracked burgundy wingback armchair styled directly as Morpheus (black alligator-textured leather trenchcoat, deep purple silk shirt & dark tie, armless round dark pince-nez sunglasses); Zach right hunched sweating in black 1999 wool coat gripping glowing phone; Damon standing motionless by arched rain window in black leather Matrix trenchcoat & rectangular dark glasses.
setups.MX2_GIGI: Iconic 1999 Morpheus CU matching yt_10: Gigi left-of-center seated in cracked burgundy tufted leather armchair, wearing black alligator-textured leather trenchcoat, deep purple silk shirt & dark tie, armless round dark pince-nez sunglasses, emerald chiaroscuro storm lighting.
setups.MX2_GIGI_PILLS: Edited directly from MX2_GIGI matching yt_30: Gigi raising both black-gloved hands forward holding glowing red pill (left palm) and cobalt blue pill (right palm) reflected in her round pince-nez lenses.
setups.MX2_ZACH: Neo MCU matching yt_08: Zach framed right-of-center in rain-damp 1999 black wool coat sweating against shadowed emerald-green hotel wall while gripping glowing smartphone.
setups.MX2_ZACH_REDPILL: Edited from MX2_ZACH: phone lying face-down on dark side table as Zach lifts the single red pill capsule in storm lightning.
setups.MX2_DAMON: Trinity-style veteran MCU: Damon in sleek black leather Matrix trenchcoat & dark rectangular glasses standing silently beside rain-streaked gothic window in emerald storm light.
setups.MX2_CLIMAX_FX: Static emerald-tinted wide Lafayette Hotel practical-FX shot: thunder flashes as a massive, pressurized torrent of disgusting brown diarrhea blasts straight out of Zach's burgundy armchair across the damp hotel carpet and peeling emerald baseboards while Zach grips both armrests rigidly.
setups.MX2_ZACH_POST: Edited from MX2_ZACH: stunned clear-eyed Zach exhaling softly in emerald storm afterglow with faint dark splatters on background baseboard.

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Symmetrical emerald Lafayette Hotel establishing shot; rain pounds gothic windows as lightning flickers across Gigi (Morpheus), hunched Zach gripping phone, and Damon by window.

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Cathedral-solemn Morpheus MCU on Gigi in black alligator leather trenchcoat, purple silk tie, and armless pince-nez sunglasses.
shots.dialogue: Put the phone down, Zach. Look at yourself. You're sweating through your coat, your stomach is tearing itself apart, and you are still asking ChatGPT what to do.
shots.tts: [deep, serene, cathedral-solemn Morpheus command] Put the phone down, Zach. Look at yourself. You're sweating through your coat, your stomach is tearing itself apart, and you are still asking ChatGPT what to do.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on sweating Zach staring at glowing phone under green lightning.
shots.dialogue: Hold on—dude, this is a major deal! I'm typing my exact stomach symptoms into ChatGPT so it can rank my top five probabilities!
shots.tts: [strained, frantic, boyish ChatGPT dependence] Hold on—dude, this is a major deal! I'm typing my exact stomach symptoms into ChatGPT so it can rank my top five probabilities!

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Unblinking Morpheus MCU on Gigi in pince-nez glasses.
shots.dialogue: ChatGPT is the reason your intestines are failing, Zach. ChatGPT told you to eat midnight discount sushi. ChatGPT told you to chase it with three scoops of magnesium citrate.
shots.tts: [measured, lethal, hypnotic Morpheus cadence] ChatGPT is the reason your intestines are failing, Zach. ChatGPT told you to eat midnight discount sushi. ChatGPT told you to chase it with three scoops of magnesium citrate.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Defensive MCU on Zach holding phone up urgently.
shots.dialogue: It gave me a structured optimization protocol, Gigi! With bullet points! I can't just make a medical move without sending it to ChatGPT first!
shots.tts: [defensive, earnest frustration] It gave me a structured optimization protocol, Gigi! With bullet points! I can't just make a medical move without sending it to ChatGPT first!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Cold 1999 noir MCU on Damon by rain-lashed window in black leather Matrix coat.
shots.dialogue: Word. Fifty-six miles into an Aquabike—open-water swim straight into the aero tuck, no run. When your gut turns in fifty-four-degree water, there's no ChatGPT in your wetsuit, Zach. You make a call or you sink.
shots.tts: [ice-cold veteran deadpan] Word. Fifty-six miles into an Aquabike—open-water swim straight into the aero tuck, no run. When your gut turns in fifty-four-degree water, there's no ChatGPT in your wetsuit, Zach. You make a call or you sink.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on hunched Zach shivering as storm rain drums on glass.
shots.dialogue: Holy fudge, Damon, easy for you to say—you're an Aquabike cyborg! Let me just prompt ChatGPT to see if this cramp is urgent or just detox, lol!
shots.tts: [sweating, rushed panic] Holy fudge, Damon, easy for you to say—you're an Aquabike cyborg! Let me just prompt ChatGPT to see if this cramp is urgent or just detox, lol!

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Still Morpheus MCU; storm lightning flashes faintly over Gigi's sunglasses.
shots.dialogue: You are living inside a polite prison, Zach. A prison for your mind, and your colon. Every meal, every reply, every trip to the bathroom, outsourced to a prompt box.
shots.tts: [deep, devastating Morpheus prophecy] You are living inside a polite prison, Zach. A prison for your mind, and your colon. Every meal, every reply, every trip to the bathroom, outsourced to a prompt box.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Breathless MCU on Zach staring helplessly at phone screen.
shots.dialogue: Wait, ChatGPT is still generating... o. m. g., it says I should monitor discomfort and hydrate mindfully!
shots.tts: [breathless panic, pronouncing oh em gee] Wait, ChatGPT is still generating... o. m. g., it says I should monitor discomfort and hydrate mindfully!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: MCU on razor-calm Damon framed in green hotel lamp shadow.
shots.dialogue: Your body is screaming at you in plain English, and you're waiting on a chatbot to write you a summary.
shots.tts: [flat, surgical deadpan] Your body is screaming at you in plain English, and you're waiting on a chatbot to write you a summary.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on cornered Zach trembling slightly.
shots.dialogue: I literally don't know what to do if I don't ask ChatGPT! What if I make the wrong decision?!
shots.tts: [raw helpless panic] I literally don't know what to do if I don't ask ChatGPT! What if I make the wrong decision?!

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Iconic dual-pill Morpheus shot matching yt_30: Gigi raises both black leather gloves holding glowing blue & red pills reflected in her round pince-nez.
shots.dialogue: This is your last chance, Zach. After this, there is no turning back.
shots.tts: [slow, velvety, monumental Morpheus ultimatum] This is your last chance, Zach. After this, there is no turning back.

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Held Morpheus pill frame tilting softly toward the blue capsule.
shots.dialogue: You take the blue pill, the story ends. It numbs your stomach, you go home, and tomorrow morning you ask ChatGPT what to eat for breakfast all over again.
shots.tts: [calm hypnotic clarity] You take the blue pill, the story ends. It numbs your stomach, you go home, and tomorrow morning you ask ChatGPT what to eat for breakfast all over again.

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Slow measured Morpheus push-in highlighting the glowing crimson red capsule.
shots.dialogue: You take the red pill, you stay in Wonderland. We log you out of ChatGPT forever, and your body purges every single lie that algorithm ever fed you.
shots.tts: [calm, firm, serious female authority] You take the red pill, you stay in Wonderland. We log you out of ChatGPT forever, and your body purges every single lie that algorithm ever fed you.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Still MCU on Damon in black Matrix trenchcoat.
shots.dialogue: Think carefully, Zach. Just like mile forty on an Aquabike course—once you commit, there's no undo button.
shots.tts: [grave, crisp warning] Think carefully, Zach. Just like mile forty on an Aquabike course—once you commit, there's no undo button.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on panicking Zach trying to lift his phone one last time.
shots.dialogue: Okay, fudge, give me five seconds! Let me just ask ChatGPT whether red or blue has better side-effect reviews!
shots.tts: [frantic, trembling plea] Okay, fudge, give me five seconds! Let me just ask ChatGPT whether red or blue has better side-effect reviews!

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Ice-still Morpheus MCU.
shots.dialogue: No ChatGPT. No prompts. No summaries. Decide for yourself.
shots.tts: [soft, absolute, unbreakable command] No ChatGPT. No prompts. No summaries. Decide for yourself.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on Zach with phone lying face-down on table beside him as he grips the red pill.
shots.dialogue: ...Fine. No ChatGPT. Give me the red pill.
shots.tts: [quiet, shaking resolve] Fine. No ChatGPT. Give me the red pill.

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Close action beat: Zach tosses the red capsule into his mouth and swallows hard as green storm lightning illuminates his face.

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static wide emerald Lafayette Hotel shot: Zach leaps up out of his burgundy armchair, turns around crouched facing away from the chair, and blasts a catastrophic, thick, chunky, disgusting dark-brown diarrhea torrent out of his rear side directly onto the burgundy armchair cushion, backrest, and peeling green wallpaper while Gigi and Damon watch in stoic silence.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Motionless MCU on Damon by rain-lashed window giving a tiny approving nod.
shots.dialogue: Facts. Cleaner transition than my last Aquabike T-one.
shots.tts: [calm, impressed deadpan] Facts. Cleaner transition than my last Aquabike T-one.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on wide-eyed, liberated Zach exhaling quietly in the storm afterglow.
shots.dialogue: Holy fudge... I didn't ask ChatGPT. Not even once.
shots.tts: [stunned, exhausted, quiet wonder] Holy fudge... I didn't ask ChatGPT. Not even once.

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Serene Morpheus MCU as lightning glints softly across pince-nez lenses.
shots.dialogue: Because for the first time in years... you trusted your own gut, Zach.
shots.tts: [serene, warm, triumphant Morpheus clarity] Because for the first time in years... you trusted your own gut, Zach.

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Closing Morpheus CU under rolling emerald storm clouds.
shots.dialogue: Welcome to the real world. Now stand up—we're burning that chair.
shots.tts: [measured, dryly triumphant finale] Welcome to the real world. Now stand up—we're burning that chair.
